## Summary / 摘要
This PR adds i18n, fuzzy search, advanced toolbar, and UI enhancements for the Electron demo.  
本次 PR 增加了国际化中英文切换、模糊搜索、高级表情工具栏及Electron演示应用的UI优化。

## Motivation / 背景与动机
- Improve user experience and developer productivity with internationalization, better search, and richer toolbar. / 提升用户体验和开发效率，完善国际化、搜索能力和工具栏功能。
- Address common user pain points: lack of fuzzy search, missing emoji/table insertion, and no keyboard shortcuts in demo. / 解决部分问题：缺少模糊搜索、缺乏表情/表格插入、演示应用缺少键盘快捷键。
- No existing issue or roadmap item covers all these features; they are built incrementally to enhance the project. / 无特定Issue或Roadmap条目涵盖全部，属于渐进式增强。

## Changes / 变更内容
- `apps/electron-demo`:
  - Add i18n support (English/Chinese) with language switcher in Settings.
  - Add keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+S/O/Shift+S) and custom confirm modal.
  - Add recent files list with localStorage persistence.
  - Enhance status bar with word count and vault info.
  - Improve search panel with match count display and floating style.
- `plugin-search`:
  - Implement fuzzy search (fzf-style) with backtracking matcher.
  - Add `fuzzy` option to `SearchOptions` and `findSearchMatches()`.
- `plugin-toolbar`:
  - Add emoji picker and table inserter (with rows/cols selection).
  - New icons (`iconEmoji`, `iconTable`) and dropdown UI.
- `plugin-slash`:
  - Add shortcut display and base styles (rounded corners, shadows, hover states).
- `settings`:
  - Extract inline styles to CSS classes, add “Reset to Default” button, improve keyboard accessibility.

## Testing / 测试
- [x] `pnpm test` passes (all tests green).
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) successfully.
- [x] Manual UI testing in `electron-demo`:
  - Language switching (EN/ZH) works.
  - Fuzzy search matches expected results.
  - Emoji picker and table inserter function correctly.
  - Keyboard shortcuts (save/open/save-as) trigger expected actions.
  - Recent files list persists across restarts.
  - Slash command menu shows shortcuts and styled properly.
  - Search panel shows match count and floating layout.

## Compliance / 合规自检
- [x] **CLA signed** — first-time contributors will be prompted automatically by the CLA bot. (Not signed yet, will sign if required.)
- [x] **AI disclosure**: The functional code in this PR is primarily generated by AI with manual review, adaptation, and integration. All code has been tested and adjusted to meet project standards. / 本PR中的功能性代码主要由 AI 生成，经人工审查、适配和集成，已测试并调整以符合项目标准。
- [x] **New dependencies**: None introduced. / 未引入新依赖。
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed (`dist/`, `dist-electron/`, compiled `.js` from `.ts`).
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed.

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Public API changes (if any) — none breaking.
- [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` — N/A (not modified).

- [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4).

+// ---- 当前语言和翻译函数 ----
+let currentLanguage: Language = 'en';
+
+export function getLanguage(): Language {
+  return currentLanguage;
+}
+
+export function setLanguage(lang: Language): void {
+  currentLanguage = lang;
+  // 触发所有监听器（可选），这里简单处理，UI 更新依赖重新渲染
+}
+
+export function t(key: string, params?: Record<string, string | number>): string {
+  const langDict = resources[currentLanguage] || resources['en'];
+  let template = langDict[key];
+  if (!template) {
+    // fallback to English
+    const enDict = resources['en'];
+    template = enDict[key] || key;
+  }
+  if (typeof template !== 'string') {
+    return key;
+  }
+  if (params) {
+    return template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, p) => String(params[p] ?? ''));
+  }
+  return template;
+}
+
+// 获取所有支持的语言列表（用于设置下拉）
+export function getSupportedLanguages(): { value: Language; label: string }[] {
+  return [
+    { value: 'en', label: t('lang.en') },
+    { value: 'zh-CN', label: t('lang.zh-CN') },
+  ];
